en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a sepia-toned photograph of a large, two-story wooden building with a long veranda, identified as Sundsvall Tivoli. Several people stand along the upper veranda, while empty tables and benches line the area below. The reverse side shows handwritten correspondence in Swedish, an address to 'Fröken Jenny Bjärke,' and Swedish postage information.
